completionEnabled.title: Enable Python AI inline completion
completionEnabled.description: Opt in to sending bounded code context to the local Gemini companion. Requires the companion service and native editor inline completion to be enabled. Keys stay in the service environment.

completionPort.title: Local completion service port
completionPort.description: Loopback only (127.0.0.1). Match AI_COMPLETION_PORT in the companion environment.

completionContextBytes.title: Maximum source context bytes
completionContextBytes.description: Total UTF-8 bytes of prefix, suffix and source hints. Must not exceed AI_COMPLETION_CONTEXT_LIMIT in the companion environment.

completionRequestTimeoutMs.title: Completion request deadline (ms)
completionRequestTimeoutMs.description: Includes the companion debounce and model response. Keep above AI_COMPLETION_DEBOUNCE + AI_COMPLETION_TIMEOUT.
